cases.purpose: Owner-settable attribute bits (s u S D d A t T c j and m C x where ext4 accepts them) render with the e2fsprogs letters at the e2fsprogs positions on a real ext4 file and directory, singly and combined, like e2fsprogs lsattr.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs lsattr on the same ext4 inode flags (set with e2fsprogs chattr; the FS_IOC_GETFLAGS word is also printed by an independent Python ioctl); letters and order per e2fsprogs.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
fl() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import fcntl,array,os,sys
fd=os.open(sys.argv[1],os.O_RDONLY); b=array.array("i",[0]); fcntl.ioctl(fd,0x80086601,b); print("%#x"%(b[0]&0xffffffff))' "$1"; }
mnt() { /usr/bin/truncate -s ${3:-6M} $1.img; $MK -q $2 -L LSA $1.img || return 1; at $1.img; D=$REPLY; reg $D LOOP; /usr/bin/mkdir -p mnt; /usr/bin/mount $D mnt; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
mnt a "-t ext4"
echo data > mnt/f; /usr/bin/mkdir mnt/dir
for X in s u S D d A t T c j m C x; do
  /usr/bin/chattr +$X mnt/f 2>/dev/null; echo "set $X stuck=$(fl mnt/f)"
  r "after +$X" lsattr mnt/f
  /usr/bin/chattr -$X mnt/f 2>/dev/null
done
for X in S D d A t T; do /usr/bin/chattr +$X mnt/dir 2>/dev/null; r "dir +$X" lsattr -d mnt/dir; /usr/bin/chattr -$X mnt/dir 2>/dev/null; done
/usr/bin/chattr +SdAu mnt/f 2>/dev/null; echo "combo stuck=$(fl mnt/f)"; r combo lsattr mnt/f

cases.purpose: Feature-dependent bits (N inline data, F casefold, P project inherit, V verity and combinations) render with the e2fsprogs order e C x F N P V m; the Python ioctl line records which flags were actually set on the guest.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs lsattr on the same ext4 inode flags (set with e2fsprogs chattr; the FS_IOC_GETFLAGS word is also printed by an independent Python ioctl); letters and order per e2fsprogs.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
fl() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import fcntl,array,os,sys
fd=os.open(sys.argv[1],os.O_RDONLY); b=array.array("i",[0]); fcntl.ioctl(fd,0x80086601,b); print("%#x"%(b[0]&0xffffffff))' "$1"; }
mnt() { /usr/bin/truncate -s ${3:-6M} $1.img; $MK -q $2 -L LSA $1.img || return 1; at $1.img; D=$REPLY; reg $D LOOP; /usr/bin/mkdir -p mnt; /usr/bin/mount $D mnt; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
mnt a "-t ext4 -b 4096 -O inline_data,casefold,project,quota,verity -E encoding=utf8" 12M || { echo "mkfs-failed"; exit 0; }
printf 'tiny\n' > mnt/inline; echo "inline stuck=$(fl mnt/inline)"; r inline lsattr mnt/inline
/usr/bin/mkdir mnt/cf; /usr/bin/chattr +F mnt/cf 2>/dev/null; echo "casefold stuck=$(fl mnt/cf)"; r casefold lsattr -d mnt/cf
/usr/bin/mkdir mnt/pj; /usr/bin/chattr +P mnt/pj 2>/dev/null; echo "project stuck=$(fl mnt/pj)"; r project lsattr -d mnt/pj
/usr/bin/mkdir mnt/combo; /usr/bin/chattr +F +P mnt/combo 2>/dev/null; echo "casefold+project stuck=$(fl mnt/combo)"; r casefold-project lsattr -d mnt/combo
/usr/bin/python3 - mnt/vf <<'PY'
import fcntl, os, struct, sys
open(sys.argv[1], "wb").write(os.urandom(8192))
fd = os.open(sys.argv[1], os.O_RDONLY)
arg = struct.pack("<IIIIQIIQ11Q", 1, 1, 4096, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, *([0] * 11))
try:
    fcntl.ioctl(fd, 0x40806685, arg); print("verity-enable=ok")
except OSError as e:
    print("verity-enable=%s" % e.strerror)
PY
echo "verity stuck=$(fl mnt/vf)"; r verity lsattr mnt/vf

cases.purpose: Immutable (i) and append-only (a) bits render at their positions, with teardown clearing them (checked by lsattr and the raw flags).
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs lsattr on the same ext4 inode flags (set with e2fsprogs chattr; the FS_IOC_GETFLAGS word is also printed by an independent Python ioctl); letters and order per e2fsprogs.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
fl() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import fcntl,array,os,sys
fd=os.open(sys.argv[1],os.O_RDONLY); b=array.array("i",[0]); fcntl.ioctl(fd,0x80086601,b); print("%#x"%(b[0]&0xffffffff))' "$1"; }
mnt() { /usr/bin/truncate -s ${3:-6M} $1.img; $MK -q $2 -L LSA $1.img || return 1; at $1.img; D=$REPLY; reg $D LOOP; /usr/bin/mkdir -p mnt; /usr/bin/mount $D mnt; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
mnt a "-t ext4"
echo data > mnt/f; echo data > mnt/g
/usr/bin/chattr +i mnt/f; echo "immutable stuck=$(fl mnt/f)"; r immutable lsattr mnt/f
/usr/bin/chattr -i mnt/f
/usr/bin/chattr +a mnt/g; echo "append stuck=$(fl mnt/g)"; r append lsattr mnt/g
/usr/bin/chattr -a mnt/g
/usr/bin/chattr +ia mnt/f; r both lsattr mnt/f; /usr/bin/chattr -ia mnt/f
echo "teardown f=$(fl mnt/f) g=$(fl mnt/g)"
r cleared lsattr mnt/f mnt/g
